description: This file is a shell script used for testing the repository's handling of branches and tags in a CVS import process. It sets up test repositories, runs import commands, and verifies branch and tag trees with expected results.

methods.name: setup_cvs_test_repository
methods.description: Sets up a CVS test repository with a specified name.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success for a given Perl command.

methods.name: test_cmp_branch_tree
methods.description: Compares the current branch tree with an expected branch name.
